The victim was beaten, forced to sign a note, then released. The act is extortion (敲诈勒索) - obtaining property by threatening to commit a crime. The victim signed a debt note for 42,000. For extortion they might label "敲诈勒索". Let's see if any example includes extortion. Not in given examples. But typical label: "敲诈勒索". So answer: [罪名]敲诈勒索<eoa>. Possibly also "非法拘禁"? He controlled victim, but released same day. He didn't detain for long. Could be "非法拘禁" but not mentioned. The main is extortion. So single crime.
